CustomReportFileTemlate.QueryText: SELECT bp.Name, bp.Id, r.[RoleId], rolename, r.description as roledescription, r.systemid, SystemDescription FROM BusinessProcessPersonRoles as br inner join [BusinessProcessPersons] as bp on bp.Id = br.BusinessProcessPersonId inner join saproles r on br.roleid = r.RoleId inner join systems s on s.SystemId = r.SystemId where bp.Name = @PackageName #Pagining#
CustomReportFileTemlate.ReportName: MS Entra IG - Get Business Role Content
